sloka: तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामभिलक्षिताः।प्रवीरानभितो जघ्नू राक्षसानां तरस्विनाम् ।। ६.७५.६४ ।।
transliteration: tathaivāpyapare teṣāṁ kapīnāmabhilakṣitāḥ।pravīrānabhito jaghnū rākṣasānāṁ tarasvinām ।। 6.75.64 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas with ears bitten off by the teeth of the monkeys, skulls smashed with fists, and limbs broken with blows of rocks they moved about.
